    • numericPolicyRangesAreShared

      public static void numericPolicyRangesAreShared(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Synthetic raw policy inputs obey the same numeric ranges before either loader publishes them. To check valid boundaries in-game, set pile height to 1 or 64, gallery permission to 0 or 4, and gallery speed to 1 in the world config, then reload and use the affected features. Invalid file values also pass through loader-specific parsing/correction; this fixture isolates the shared policy constructor and does not change the running world's policy.

    • listEditsPublishImmutablePolicy

    • reloadCommandPublishesStoredPolicy

      public static void reloadCommandPublishesStoredPolicy(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: while the server runs, add a mod id to render_gallery.gen_mods in the world's somestacks-server.toml (Forge) or somestacks-server.json (Fabric), then run /ss reload. The reply counts online players, and /ss gen mod list shows the new entry. The fixture writes the stored policy through the loader's saver without publishing it, and restores both the file and the published policy afterward.
